respuesta.pregunta: For demand-forecast-docs latest: what does `rda workflow prepare` actually give me, and once I have that, what's the exact command and which flags do I pass to execute a specific plan?
respuesta.respuesta:
`rda workflow prepare` creates a **workflow plan**. When you run it, you also give some other parameters, such as the name and the version. The plan is a frozen version of the workflow, the workflow equivalent of a task-image [demand-forecast-docs/latest/guide/overview.md:L199-L199]. The workflow flowchart shows that the plan becomes an execution through `rda workflow run` [demand-forecast-docs/latest/guide/overview.md:L196-L196].

The documentation doesn't tell you how to run it, though. The step for this only says "We run a specific plan" [demand-forecast-docs/latest/guide/overview.md:L199-L199]. It gives no syntax for `rda workflow run`, no arguments or flags, and no example of how to pick the plan. So I can't give you the exact command or its flags from this documentation.
